claim.claim-text: 1. A fluid management system (10) for use in an endoscopic procedure, comprising:
2. The system (10) of claim 1, wherein the filter system characteristics and outflow rate are further selected to substantially prevent hemolysis of filtered red blood cells.

3. The system (10) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the filter system characteristics are further selected to ensure that the filtrate causes no substantial effect on an extrinsic coagulation pathway as verified by a Prothrombin Time assay.

4. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein the filter system characteristics are further selected to ensure that the filtrate causes no substantial effect on an intrinsic coagulation pathway as verified by an Unactivated Partial Thromboplastic Time assay.

5. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein the filter system characteristics are further selected to insure that the filtrate causes substantially no activation of an immune system pathway as verified by a Complement Activation assay evaluating at least one of the protein complements C3A and C5b.

6. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein the filter system characteristics are further selected to ensure that the filtrate causes no substantial effect on platelet aggregation as verified by a Platelet Aggregation assay.

7. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein the control algorithms control the outflow rate to thereby limit pressure at the filter system (180) to a maximum of 6.9 * 10<5> Pa (100 psi) or less.;8. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic comprises hollow filter fibers with a total lumen surface area of at least 0.5 m<2>.;9. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic is a flow- through capacity of at least 500 ml/min.;10. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic comprises hollow fibers having a nominal molecular weight limit (NMWL) of 50 kDa or less.;11. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic comprises back pressure at the filter system of 3.5 * 10<5> Pa (5 psi) or less.
12. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein the filter system characteristics and outflow rate are selected to prevent hemolysis of greater than 5% of filtered red blood cells.
13. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic is a filtration capacity of at least 40 ml of blood.
14. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic is a filtration capacity of at least 60 ml of blood.
15. The system (10) of any preceding claim, wherein a filter system characteristic is a filtration capacity of at least 80 ml of blood.
